title: feat(types): slider/tooltip single-or-list keys follow their read sites (objectui#7759 group B)
body:
Closes #10280
Part of #7759 (group B only; groups C, D, E and F stay open on that card)
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

objectui#7759 group B: three single-or-list keys where the zod mirror accepted a spelling the TypeScript declaration refused. None of them is declared by `@objectstack/spec`, so the director's rule 2 (comment 5617465269) applies: an objectui-own key follows its read site, and the mirror and declaration both describe it.

| key | spec declares it? | read site | change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SliderSchema.defaultValue` | no | `renderers/form/slider.tsx` turns a scalar into a list on purpose | **declaration widened** to `number \| number[]` (the mirror is unchanged) |
| `SliderSchema.value` | no | none | **retired on both faces**: mirror `retirementTombstone(...)`, declaration `value?: never` |
| `TooltipSchema.content` | no | `renderers/overlay/tooltip.tsx` puts `schema.content` raw in a React child position | **mirror narrowed** to `SchemaNodeSchema`, the declaration's `string \| SchemaNode` (the declaration is unchanged) |

The resolved rows leave `WiderThanDeclared` and `WIDER_ARMS` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`. The header figures moved from 19 / 29 / 36 (5 / 24 / 0 / 7) to 17 / 26 / 30 (5 / 21 / 0 / 4). The figure pin re-derives these numbers, and the ledger has a prose entry for the move.

## Is the key declared by the spec? (evidence)

- Installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` (`src` and `dist`): `grep -rlE 'SliderSchema|TooltipSchema'` found **0** files. The control grep `PageHeaderSchema|ListViewSchema` found 3 files in the same tree.
- objectstack `origin/main` `2c1011b`: `git grep -nE "SliderSchema|TooltipSchema" -- packages/spec` found **0** hits. The spec uses `slider` only as a data **field type** (`field.zod.ts` `FieldType`), which is a different surface from the objectui `type: 'slider'` component node. The only tooltip hit in `component.zod.ts` is the unrelated gantt `tooltipFields`.

## Runtime evidence (a one-off probe through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry; not committed)

- Slider `defaultValue: 30` and `defaultValue: [30]` both render a thumb with `aria-valuenow="30"`.
- Slider `value`: the DOM for `{defaultValue:[30]}` is byte-identical to the DOM for `{defaultValue:[30], value:[80]}` and for `{..., value: 80}` (`innerHTML` equal: true, true). The renderer reads `defaultValue` / `max` / `min` / `step`. `toFormControlDomProps` drops `value` from the props spread.
- Tooltip `content`: a string renders. **A list renders the error boundary** "Component "tooltip" failed to render / Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, content})". This confirms that the list arm breaks at the read site.

## Pins and reverse verification

New file: `packages/types/src/__tests__/slider-tooltip-single-or-list-10280.test.ts`. Reverse verification was run after the fix was committed (`36e074afe`). Each leg used `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 -> x0, blob changed). Each restore was proven with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **A: declaration reverted to `number[]`.** `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` went red: the new pin's `Expect` (TS2344), the scalar assignment (TS2322), and the parity ledger (the `SliderSchema` pair and the `defaultValue` key both reported as not in the ledger).
- **B: `value` tombstone reverted to the union.** vitest went red: `2 failed | 9 passed (11)`, from the two `refuses ... at value` cases.
- **C: `content` mirror reverted to the list union.** vitest went red: `1 failed | 47 passed (48)` (`refuses a list at content`). tsc went red on the parity ledger (the `TooltipSchema` pair and the `content` key).
- **Cross-package check** (after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' run build`): in `slider.tsx`, `defaultValue={defaultValue}` was changed to `defaultValue={schema.defaultValue}`. components `tsc` reported `TS2322 Type 'number | number[] | undefined' is not assignable to type 'number[] | undefined'`. This shows that the consumer reads the rebuilt `.d.ts`. The file was then restored and proven.

## Local gates (final head `e2a83bc32`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: `Test Files 215 passed (215)`, `Tests 4937 passed (4937)`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' run build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check`: exit 0. Downstream direction: components is the only package that imports `SliderSchema` / `TooltipSchema` outside `packages/types`.
- Consumer tests (run on `36e074afe`): `pnpm exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/test/ packages/components/src/__tests__/form-renderers.test.tsx`: `34 passed (34)`, `2218 passed (2218)`.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:doc-types`, `check:test-path-roots`: all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 6 paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint, narrowed to the 5 changed lintable files with `--no-inline-config --format json`. (1) `--print-config` resolves a config for all 5 files. (2) The JSON output lists 5 files: 0 errors and 12 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` on lines this diff does not touch. (3) `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the result for any untouched file. Run on `36e074afe`; the merge added no types or lint-relevant files.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` (both exit 2, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need a scoped 34-package build). Instead, the two catalog documents that author these nodes were read: `basic-slider.json` uses `defaultValue: [50]` and `basic-tooltip.json` uses a string `content`. Neither uses a spelling this change refuses.

## Acceptance notes

- `TooltipSchema.content`'s declared **single-node** arm also fails at the read site. The same probe renders `content: {type:'text', ...}` into the same "Objects are not valid as a React child" error boundary. This PR narrows the mirror only to the declared union, as dispatched. The remaining object arm is reported to the seat as a separate finding: it needs a choice between narrowing both faces to primitives and rendering `content` through `renderChildren`.
- `content/docs/components/overlay/tooltip.mdx` still lists `body` as the rich-content half (retired by objectui#6771). `content/docs/components/form/slider.mdx` shows `defaultValue?: number` and does not show the list arm. Both files are documentation drift outside this claim's file surface and were not changed.
- The ruling's open question about `content || children` (an author who writes both loses `children` silently) is not addressed here.
- Merge with the group E PR: both PRs edit `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (different rows) and the pinned header figures. Whichever lands second re-derives the figures by merging `main`.

The session reference for this change is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`, dispatched by the `domain:spec#1` seat.
